want: to see transfer activity (like a Mandiri CC payment) on the Insights page without it being silently dropped
soThat: I can see both my real spending and how much I've paid onto a wallet like a credit card, without transfers between my own accounts inflating the Income or Expenses totals
acceptance: each currency section shows a Transfer In and a Transfer Out total, separate from Income and Expenses
Transfer In sums transfer transactions landing on a wallet in the current filter scope; Transfer Out sums transfer transactions leaving a wallet in scope
Income and Expenses totals are unaffected by transfers, so they still reflect only real money in and out
clicking Transfer In or Transfer Out expands it to show the underlying transfer transactions, the same way a category row expands
when there is no income, expense, or transfer activity for the period, the No Data state still shows
